entities.summary: Anfisa Maksimovna Ageeva, also Anfisa/Anfissa Agejeva/Ageyeva is a Russian Kildin Sámi author, translator, musician, and activist. In 2001, she was the first Sámi person from Russia to participate in the Sámi Grand Prix and the first to win it.
